title: Robot Pool Cleaners That Do the Dirty Work for You
summary:
Swimming pools are awesome, but cleaning them? Not so much. Imagine scooping leaves and dirt with a net when it's 100 degrees outside. No thanks! That's why robotic pool cleaners are so cool. They do the dirty work for you.

A pool expert tested a bunch of these robots. The best one is the Beatbot AquaSense 2 Ultra. It can clean the floor, walls, and even the waterline. It has a powerful battery that lasts six hours, and it can skim the surface too. When it's done, it floats, so you can just grab it from the deck. But it's heavy—29 pounds! And it costs about $3,000. That's a lot of money.

If you want something cheaper, there's the Beatbot Sora 70 for $1,499. Or the Dreame Z1 Pro, which used to be $1,499 but is now only $499. It's not perfect, but it's great for smaller pools. It even has a remote control that can call the robot to the surface.

There's also the iGarden M1-AI, which has a huge battery. You can leave it in the pool for a week or more, and it cleans on a schedule. It looks like a racecar, which is pretty cool. So if you have a pool, maybe it's time to let a robot do the work!
why_it_matters: If your family has a pool or you know someone who does, this shows how technology can replace a boring chore, even if it costs a lot.
